flags: PIN OFF ~2.1 km: stored 39.5681,-75.7303 is in unbroken forest north-west of the lake, near no campground. The RV loops (units visible on imagery, bathhouse at the centre) are south of the lake at about 39.5516,-75.7181. RV Life's pin 39.54848,-75.71821 sits just south of them. Corrected: 39.5516,-75.7181.

WATERFRONT not waterfront stands, and AWH's note agrees: the north loop road lies between the northernmost sites and the lake arm, with ~80-100 m of forest beyond it. ReserveAmerica gives no site a water-proximity value. I did not read the sites' photos for a filtered view, because the road and canopy already fail on-water and AWH's firsthand note says not lakefront.
